what.title: What is a heart attack? STEMI, NSTEMI, the five types and survival
what.description: How common heart attacks are, STEMI versus NSTEMI, the five types of MI, myocardial injury versus infarction, and survival shown as population statistics.

plaque.title: Atherosclerosis and plaque rupture: how a coronary clot forms
plaque.description: Animated guide to coronary plaque: LDL in the artery wall, fatty streak, thin-cap fibroatheroma, rupture vs erosion, and the clot behind a heart attack.

ischaemia.title: Time is muscle: how heart muscle dies in a heart attack
ischaemia.description: Scrub the ischaemic wavefront hour by hour, reopen the artery to see salvage, and compare delay with outcomes in PCI, fibrinolysis and cardiac MRI data.

risk.title: Heart attack risk factors: INTERHEART, LDL, Lp(a) and prevention
risk.description: INTERHEART's nine modifiable risk factors and their odds ratios, plus a teaching explorer for smoking, blood pressure, LDL, diabetes, Lp(a) and women's risks.

symptoms.title: Heart attack symptoms in women and men, and without chest pain
symptoms.description: Where heart attack pain is felt, extra symptoms in women vs men, why 1 in 3 had no chest pain in NRMI-2, and words that delay calling for help. Cited.

ecg.title: Heart attack ECG: STEMI criteria, Q waves and lead territories
ecg.description: Watch an ECG evolve after a heart attack: hyperacute T, ST elevation, Q waves. Test UDMI4 STEMI thresholds by lead, age and sex. Posterior MI, LBBB.

troponin.title: Troponin after a heart attack: hs-troponin and the 0/1-hour algorithm
troponin.description: How troponin rises and falls after a heart attack, sex-specific 99th percentiles, the ESC 0/1-hour rule-out algorithm, and injury vs type 1 and type 2 MI.

scores.title: HEART, TIMI and GRACE scores: teaching calculators and event rates
scores.description: Build the HEART score item by item, see 6-week event rates by band, try teaching HEART and TIMI calculators, and see what GRACE weighs. Not for triage.

differential.title: Chest pain: heart attack, aortic dissection, PE, takotsubo or SCAD?
differential.description: Animated chest map of heart attack mimics: aortic dissection, pulmonary embolism, pericarditis, takotsubo, SCAD and MINOCA, with which test helps each.

call.title: Heart attack first minutes: calling 911/999/112, CPR and AEDs
call.description: Why to call an ambulance rather than drive, the prehospital ECG, and how bystander CPR and public defibrillators change cardiac arrest survival.

reperfusion.title: Reperfusion in STEMI: primary PCI vs fibrinolysis and time targets
reperfusion.description: Primary PCI and clot-busting drugs raced against the ESC 120-minute target, Keeley 2003 outcomes, door-to-balloon delay, radial access and COMPLETE.

antithrombotic.title: Aspirin, P2Y12 inhibitors and DAPT after a heart attack, explained
antithrombotic.description: How aspirin, clopidogrel, prasugrel and ticagrelor block platelets, what ISIS-2, CURE, TRITON and PLATO found, and how DAPT trades clots for bleeding.

complications.title: Heart attack complications: arrhythmias, rupture and cardiogenic shock
complications.description: When VF, heart block, AF, heart wall rupture, LV clot, pericarditis and heart failure appear after a heart attack, plus SHOCK, IABP and DanGer Shock trials.

secondary.title: Medicines after a heart attack: statins, beta-blockers, ACE inhibitors
secondary.description: Why each medicine after a heart attack is used and the trial behind it, from aspirin and statins to beta-blockers after REDUCE-AMI, MRAs and SGLT2 drugs.

lipids.title: Lowering LDL cholesterol after a heart attack: targets and medicines
lipids.description: How far to lower LDL cholesterol after a heart attack and why: the CTT evidence, statins, ezetimibe, PCSK9 inhibitors, bempedoic acid and the ESC goals.

cabg.title: Stents or bypass after a heart attack? PCI vs CABG trials explained
cabg.description: PCI stents or CABG bypass grafts for one, three or left main arteries and diabetes: SYNTAX 10-year, FREEDOM, EXCEL and NOBLE results, LIMA grafts, ISCHEMIA.

rehab.title: Cardiac rehabilitation after a heart attack: benefits and access gaps
rehab.description: How cardiac rehab works week by week, what Cochrane trials show for heart attacks and hospital admissions, home vs centre, and the US participation gap.

living.title: Cardiac rehabilitation after a heart attack: benefits and access gaps
living.description: The first year after a heart attack: readmission risk, flying, sex, return to work, depression, anxiety and PTSD rates, plus a recovery checklist to keep.

nursing.title: Nursing care for heart attack (MI): ECG, oxygen, access site, NCLEX
nursing.description: Nursing priorities in myocardial infarction from door-to-ECG to discharge: oxygen trials, morphine and ticagrelor, radial vs femoral care, NCLEX-style quiz.

frontier.title: Heart attack research: colchicine, Lp(a), inclisiran and AI ECG trials
frontier.description: Where new heart attack treatments stand: colchicine, IL-6 drugs, Lp(a) lowering, inclisiran, cell therapy, the polypill and AI ECG, with evidence labels.

history.title: History of heart attack care: from Herrick to stents and troponin
history.description: Heart attack history, animated: Herrick 1912, the ECG, coronary care units, clot-busting drugs and aspirin, angioplasty, stents and the troponin era.

review.title: Heart attack flashcards and mnemonics: MI facts by part, cited
review.description: 88 cited flashcards on heart attack, from plaque and the ECG to PCI, DAPT and rehab, ten memory aids, and an animated guide to the STEMI time targets.

quiz.title: Heart attack quiz: 98 cited questions on MI diagnosis and care
quiz.description: Multiple-choice quiz on heart attack with cited answers: troponin, ECG criteria, HEART and GRACE, PCI and fibrinolysis, antiplatelets, shock and rehab.

glossary.title: Heart attack glossary: MI terms from troponin to DAPT explained
glossary.description: 164 searchable, cited heart attack terms, from thin-cap fibroatheroma and the 99th-percentile troponin limit to Sgarbossa, door-to-balloon and SCAI stages.

sources.title: Heart Attack Companion sources: the references behind every claim
sources.description: Every journal article, systematic review, guideline, drug label and trial record behind the Heart Attack Companion, searchable and filterable by area.
